correctness.rationale: Exact triangulated bipyramid reconstruction yields all facet normal directions and equal area 2pi/n. Supporting halfspaces give r=b/sqrt3 and uniqueness, antipodal poles and comparison b>=a give unique enclosing ball R=b, and d_H=max{b-1,1-b/sqrt3}=b-1 by the n>=4 threshold. Strict decrease of x cot x on (0,pi/4] proves b_n strictly increases. Direct two-pyramid volume is 4pi b/(3sqrt3), and fourth vertical moment 1/9 rules out degree-4 design. The analytic proof is all-n; independently reconstructed finite hull calculations passed 16023 assertions.

value.rationale: A motivated exact boundary example for sphericity of the equal-area Minkowski realizations of spherical designs: adding arbitrarily many facets at fixed exact polynomial strength worsens Hausdorff approximation even as volume increases at constant surface area. The exact inequality and double-cone limit separate cardinality from increasing design strength. This is a structural family-wide geometric result, not a renamed design construction or a single unmotivated constant.
